verse.verse_1: By those (angels) that pluck out the soul from depths,
verse.verse_3: and by those that speedily glide along (the cosmos),
verse.verse_4: and vie with the others (in carrying out their Lord's behests);
verse.verse_5: and then manage the affairs of the Universe (according to their Lord's commands).
verse.verse_6: The Day when the quaking will cause a violent convulsion,
verse.verse_7: and will be followed by another quaking.
verse.verse_8: On that Day some hearts shall tremble (with fright),
verse.verse_9: and their eyes shall be downcast with dread.
verse.verse_10: They say: “Shall we indeed be restored to life,
verse.verse_11: even after we have been reduced to bones, hollow and rotten?”
verse.verse_12: They say: “That will then be a return with a great loss!”
verse.verse_13: Surely they will need no more than a single stern blast,
verse.verse_14: and lo, they will all be in the open plain.
verse.verse_16: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
verse.verse_17: and directed him: “Go to Pharaoh, he has rebelled,
verse.verse_18: and say to him: 'Are you willing to be purified,
verse.verse_19: that I may direct you to your Lord and then you hold Him in awe?'”
verse.verse_20: Then Moses (went to Pharaoh and) showed him the Great Sign;
verse.verse_21: but he denied it as false and disobeyed,
verse.verse_22: and then he turned back to have recourse to his craftiness,
verse.verse_23: and gathered his people and declared:
verse.verse_24: “I am the supreme lord of you all.”
verse.verse_25: Thereupon Allah seized him for the chastisement of the World to Come as well as of the present.
verse.verse_26: Surely there is a great lesson in it for whoever would fear (Allah).
verse.verse_27: Is it harder to create you or the heaven? But Allah built it,
verse.verse_28: and raised its vault high and proportioned it;
verse.verse_29: and covered its night with darkness and brought forth from it its day;
verse.verse_30: and thereafter spread out the earth,
verse.verse_31: and brought out of it its water and its pasture,
verse.verse_32: and firmly fixed in it mountains;
verse.verse_33: all this as provision for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: But when the great calamity will come about
verse.verse_35: on the Day when man will recall all his strivings,
verse.verse_36: and Hell will be brought in sight for anyone to see:
verse.verse_38: and preferred the life of this world,
verse.verse_39: most surely his abode shall be Hell.
verse.verse_40: But he who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained himself from evil desires,
verse.verse_41: most surely his abode shall be Paradise.
verse.verse_42: They ask you about the Hour: “When will it be?”
verse.verse_43: What concern do you have to speak about that?
verse.verse_44: Its knowledge rests with your Lord.
verse.verse_45: You are only a warner to him who has a fear of it.
verse.verse_46: On the Day they see it, they will feel as though they had stayed (in the grave) no more than one evening or one morning.
